The main takeaway from our work is that
MT may have a role in patients with NSCLC, but it has to be considered as an additional treatment option and not as an obligatory one.

MT should be used in patients with good performance status, in the context of clinical trials or in patients who have demonstrated a good response to induction chemotherapy, in order to prolong progression free survival.
